{{Top|leg}}
'''Geggis Pek''' was a renowned [[Musician/Legends|musician]] who performed in the [[Crimson Casino]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] resort [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] at some point prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the tenure of [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]] as the station's [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]].
